First, find the derivative f'(x). Set f'(x) = 0 and solve for x. These x-values are potential stationary points. Plug them back into the original function to get y-values. replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variation. First, standardize your data.
